baseline_results.note: Baseline (original code, no changes) also produces non-deterministic outputs

optimized_results.note: Optimized code (event-based sync + hit/miss split + speculative prefetch)

improvement.description: Event-based async sync reduces per-token latency from 145.28ms to 128.65ms (11.4% improvement)

correctness_assessment.note: Idempotency test fails on BOTH baseline and optimized code. This is a pre-existing issue with expert offloading non-determinism due to cache eviction patterns. Model produces coherent output in both cases. No crashes or exceptions. Our changes do not introduce any new correctness issues.
correctness_assessment.evidence: baseline_test.json shows same non-deterministic behavior without our changes
